info.name: Risk Cloud Access Audit Field API

params.name: application-id
params.description: The unique ID of an application where, if provided, the response will only contain fields from the identified application

params.name: workflow-id
params.description: The unique ID of a workflow where, if provided, the response will only contain fields from the identified workflow

params.name: step-id
params.description: The unique ID of a step where, if provided, the response will only contain fields from the identified step

params.name: field-type
params.description: A field type where, if provided, the response will only contain fields of the identified field type

params.name: scope
params.description: A scope where, if provided, the response will only contain fields that have either global or workflow scopes (defaults to ALL)

params.name: page
params.description: The zero-indexed page number (must not be less than 0, defaults to 0)

params.name: size
params.description: The size of the page and maximum number of items to be returned (must not be less than 1, defaults to 20)

items.docs:
**Permissions:** [Build Access](https://help.logicgate.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402683190164-Control-Build-Access-for-Applications)

Retrieve a page of all fields whose parent application the current user has [Build Access](https://help.logicgate.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402683190164-Control-Build-Access-for-Applications) to.
